title: Raw agent summary source
description: Input agent-summary.json produced by benchmark runners before normalization. Snake-case source fields are retained so ingestion can be audited.

schema_version.description: Required for new raw writers; historical fixtures may omit it.

agent_id.description: Raw agent ID when separately recorded.

agent_kind.description: Runner family such as tura or codex.

agent_mode.description: Runner profile such as direct, balanced, or cli.

model.description: Exact model string reported by the raw runner. Normalization must not rewrite a 5.6 source as 5.5 or vice versa.

tura_model.description: Tura-specific requested model alias when present.

task_id.description: Stable task ID when separately recorded.

workspace.description: Raw workspace path. Normalized/public contracts replace this with repository-relative paths or URLs.

timed_out.description: Whether the runner terminated on timeout.

first_output_ms.description: Milliseconds until first observable agent output.

last_progress_ms.description: Time of last progress relative to run start.

error.description: Runner-level error. Harness failures belong in harness-report, not here.

provider_log_path.description: Provider log file or directory used to recover requests and responses.

usage.description: Raw run-level token counters. The normalizer deduplicates cumulative usage updates before publication.

cache_write_tokens.description: Cache-write tokens for providers that report them.

latency_ms.description: Provider latency aggregation reported by the runner.

usage_source.description: Artifact/method used to compute raw usage.

provider_calls.description: Provider call count or runner-native provider-call summary.

rounds.description: Raw round count or runner-native round summary.

events.description: Event counts used to detect missing or duplicated extraction.

eval.description: Runner-native evaluator summary when available. Standard publication uses harness-report.json.
